[RLOW.6.1.1] Every DS binary operator lowers to a `binop` expression node
(`proto/rete_expr.proto#BinopExpr`) carrying its `BinopOp`; every unary
operator but `+` to a `unop` node (`proto/rete_expr.proto#UnopExpr`) carrying
its `UnopOp`. Unary `+` lowers to its operand, with no node of its own.

| DS operator | Node and op |
|---|---|
| `+` `-` `*` `/` | `binop`: `BINOP_ADD`, `_SUB`, `_MUL`, `_DIV` |
| `//` `%` | `binop`: `BINOP_IDIV`, `_MOD` |
| `==` `!=` `<` `>` `<=` `>=` | `binop`: `BINOP_EQ`, `_NE`, `_LT`, `_GT`, `_LE`, `_GE` |
| `and` `or` | `binop`: `BINOP_AND`, `_OR` (absorbing, [LNUL.4.2]) |
| `&` `\|` `^` `<<` `>>` | `binop`: `BINOP_BAND`, `_BOR`, `_BXOR`, `_SHL`, `_SHR` |
| `~` | `unop`: `UNOP_BNOT` |
| `not` | `unop`: `UNOP_NOT` |
| unary `-` | `unop`: `UNOP_NEG` |

The operator set and each operator's operand types are [LEXP.1]'s.
